added_failures_note: The reviewed run is a read-only audit that ran no suite, so there is no base/head arm pair to difference; the count is recorded as 0 with an empty list because the reviewed run carries no suite-delta waiver, and it measures no gate.

claim_summary.detail: The report's summary line states 'The two decisive currency findings: s2 and s4 are close to closed, s5 and s6 are not; and the s6 compile bounds are superseded by the 2026-11-18 kernel-compile-barrier ruling'. The table beneath gives s2 7 met / 1 partly of 8, s4 5 met / 2 partly of 7, s5 0 met / 1 partly / 3 not met / 1 superseded of 5, and s6 0 met / 4 not met of 4; the summary's qualitative figures match the table row-for-row, and C1 records the compile-bounds supersession. It agrees.

claims.detail: S2-1 met: from the reviewed worktree at 5c503f9a8, tests/test_read_ten_thousand_cells.py:29 asserts norm(result.axis - analytic) <= pitch and, for the diverted case, exactly one X-point within pitch, parametrised over (limited, diverted) x (550, 2000, 5000, 10000); fragment docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/cfs-read-ten-thousand.html:33 (anchor cfs-read-ten-thousand-diverted-growth) states 'At 10,000 cells the axis and admitted X-point errors are 2.63e-13 and 7.44e-14 pitches' -- the axis 2.63e-13 and X-point 7.44e-14 figures the report quotes, reproduced exactly.

S5-1 not met: from the reviewed worktree at 5c503f9a8, grep finds fixed_point.newton_krylov called at nova/equilibrium/forward.py:2113 and :2123 (also :2277); grep 'solve.fixed_point' finds seven test callers in tests/test_equilibrium_solve.py and exactly one prototype caller (scripts/prototypes/batched_factor/measure.py:662) and none under nova/; solve.fixed_point is dense chord-Newton (_cold/_chord) at nova/equilibrium/solve.py:229-247 and SolveResult carries only state, residual, converged, corrections, factor (:47-61). The report's 'production still solves with fixed_point.newton_krylov; solve.fixed_point has only test and prototype callers; implemented solver is dense chord-Newton' reproduces.

C1 / S5-4 superseded: from the reviewed worktree at 5c503f9a8, docs/plans/kernel-compile-barrier.html carries the 2026-11-18 ruling the report quotes -- 'For this plan those cold-compile bounds are superseded by the lead's ruling of 2026-11-18: the cold compile is recorded and carries no bound, and the 60 s and 64 GB apply to the first call of a program served from the pinned pre-warm cache ... The acceptance table of converged-forward-solve still reads as a cold-compile clause, and restating it is that plan's edit'; docs/plans/converged-forward-solve.html:81-82 still states '<= 60 s on the H200, warm cache excluded' and '<= 64 GB resident on the host'. The supersession finding reproduces.

findings.text: Minor citation imprecision, not material to the finding: S5-1 writes 'imports at :129', but nova/equilibrium/forward.py:129 imports reduced_newton while fixed_point is imported at :97; the production-call claim the citation supports is nonetheless correct.
